body:
Hello y'all, this is my first mod, and it will be updated constantly to add features that make the dessert a more interesting biome

currently, the Mod doesn't improve the survival experience to a meaningful degree.

Features:

-New ore
-Future Mob Items (currently with no use)

Currently working on:

-New Mob named Bingus
-Items that utilize the Mob's Drops, and New Ore.


Mob spoiler:
A desert dweller shrouded in mystery, Bingus blends with the sands, guarding secrets and treasures. Approaching cautiously is advised, for its true nature is hidden beneath the surface.

Usage:

-You can try out this very beta version of my mod via NeoForge
-currently no configurations

(Mod to improve survival, and creative experience)
